notes:
Changes:
- The store is now public for everyone! Get themes, extensions and various presets right from the new storefront
- In a short window the expanded player hides the title and artist, which the player bar already shows
Fixes:
- With more than one login saved, Kodama started with the oldest one and appeared signed out after every restart
- Renew Session in the library added a new login instead of renewing the current one
- After an update, every start copied the 81 MB Node runtime again and left a copy behind
- With Close to Tray off, closing the window left Kodama running in the tray with no way to reopen it
- The linear visualizer's bars squeezed together as the window got smaller
- Resizing the split view between visualizer and lyrics stuttered
